row:
Welcome to Physiovedic Physiotherapy Clinic! We have been providing top-notch physiotherapy services for the past 10 years, and we take pride in being one of the most trusted and reliable clinics in the area.

At Physiovedic, our experienced and dedicated team of physiotherapists use a holistic approach to help our clients achieve their health and wellness goals.

So, whether you're looking for pain relief, injury rehabilitation, or simply want to improve your overall health and wellness, come visit us at Physiovedic Physiotherapy Clinic. Let us help you get back to doing the things you love!
Treatment for
*Neck Pain
*Back Pain
*Knee Pain(Arthritis)
*Stroke(Paralysis)
*Postural Correction
*Frozen Shoulder
*Cupping Therapy
*Sports Injuries
*Sciatica
*Facial Palsy
*Joint Pain


Dr Zeeshan Ali (PT)
(Consultant Physiotherapist)
Address - Back gate of navyug radiance school Rajendra Nagar Lucknow 226004 
Call - 9807734275
Website -www.physiovedic.com
Email- healsphysio@gmail.com
